primary_question: Can a new complete authenticated representation preserve the fast native encrypted-search evaluator and compact client reply without repeated trusted index work or relocated dense state? Can a restricted finite adaptive-lifetime bound add a useful, nonheuristic consequence?

contracts.primary_output: All exact stable-ID/Hamming-score pairs, with stable local top-three selection
contracts.data_ownership: Owner/client may retain all plaintext and any summaries; no cache prohibition

routes.new_result_required: A restricted finite nonheuristic tail bound for an actual reused-key dependency graph, handling a new case and changing a useful cryptographic resource choice
routes.theorem_target: Unconditional good-setup failure epsilon_epoch plus conditional per-legal-adaptive-query delta_i, giving epsilon_epoch + sum_i delta_i for the stated lifetime; union bound itself is known
method_proposals: Valid conditioning or filtration of still-fresh coins
Exact finite MGFs or certified concentration
Deterministic bounds on fixed source/key residuals
strongest_controls: E97/E99 fixed-input rounding and gadget controls
stop_conditions: Depends on posterior IID or unquantified Gaussian tail
MGF coefficient uses the same fresh randomness without valid conditioning
Finite bound vacuous at useful sizes
Claims smaller Q or sparse security without matching assurance
routes.parameter_note: Correctness bounds, heuristic hardness estimates, and parameter approval are distinct; actual full-N sparse/derived-key transcript remains open

routes.new_result_required: A distinct owner summary/block/coverage representation with useful complete exact-top-three retrieval under declared traffic privacy and permitted caches

strongest_controls: PANTHER/SANNS clustering and private candidate retrieval
stop_conditions: Unfetched-row coverage or stable ties missing
Fixed privacy padding erases the gain
AEAD treated as a pre-decryption gate for outer HE
